summary.text: Guy Ward is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 74, appointed in January 2026 after earlier service in the House, and is running for election to the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election. He previously represented District 50.

paragraphs.text: Guy Ward was born in Grafton and lives in White Hall, West Virginia.
He graduated from Grafton High School in 1974 and earned an associate degree from Fairmont State College.
His career experience includes working as a material analyst with First Energy and as operations and project manager with Fairmont Community Development Partnership.
Ward previously served in the House of Delegates for District 50, from 2016 to 2018 and from 2020 to 2022.
He was appointed to District 74, succeeding Republican Mike DeVault, on January 27, 2026, assumed office on January 29, 2026, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
